sampling: Ordinary paired participant bootstrap; one resample of training participants is shared by every model and all three partitions in each replicate
statistic: Raw-frame minus cached feature performance, averaged over the three fixed outer-fold partitions; five-class macro-F1 is primary
interval: Pointwise 2.5th and 97.5th percentiles, conditional on the saved fitted models and observed dataset
comparisons: All four predeclared raw-versus-cached pairs: A and AV, each ordinary and class-balanced
limitations: Exploratory analysis after original final-test exposure. Does not capture training-set/model-refitting uncertainty or establish independent generalization. Partitions share participants and are never resampled as independent observations. Four comparisons are unadjusted for multiplicity. No validation/test scoring, model selection or promotion.
